title: IntelliCore Event
description: Common telemetry event contract for LLM, Agentic AI, and ML systems.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the telemetry event.

timestamp.description: Time at which the event occurred.

system_type.description: AI system paradigm that generated the event.

model_id.description: Model or model-version identifier when applicable.

span_id.description: Identifier for one operation within a trace.

event_type.description: Type of telemetry event, such as LLM call, tool call, prediction, or monitoring signal.

input.description: Relevant input payload or safe reference.

output.description: Relevant output payload or safe reference.
